title: An image digest held to three days
assertion: A digest new against the base's Dockerfiles, compose file and workflows passes on a pull request only when Docker Hub pushed it at least three days ago; a superseded or unreadable digest fails closed; an unchanged digest is never read; on a push a finding warns
noFileReason: The Dockerfiles, docker-compose.yml and the workflows are read, at the head and in synthetic base trees; Docker Hub's answers are synthetic and recorded; no file.
